peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 20.1% above its local comparables; 124 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (71.8): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 277 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 10). Initial resale-wave effect: 12 of the 22 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Jan 2025–Dec 2025), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 62.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,370,000 ($2,718 psf, 462–505 sq ft; 5 resales, May 2023–Apr 2025); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,270 psf (range $1,995–2,348); 19.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $226,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,868,000 ($2,865 psf, 624–764 sq ft; 9 resales, Mar 2024–Feb 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,378 psf (range $1,845–3,072); 20.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $318,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Jan 2025 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 4 earlier resales do not start the wave. 9 months available from Jan 2026; measurable with data to Dec 2026. Observed: 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Cantonment MRT about 250 m, Outram Park MRT about 350 m; closer than 539 of 662 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 1 within 2 km; nearest Zhangde Primary School about 1,640 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 540 m), more than 243 of 662 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Blk 6 Tanjong Pagar Plaza Market And Food Centre about 560 m; nearest park Duxton Plain Park about 430 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Newport Residences, 203 new sales, about 690 m; TMW Maxwell, 1 new sales, about 820 m; Skywaters Residences, 5 new sales, about 1,010 m; W Residences Marina View - Singapore, 14 new sales, about 1,300 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 1,460 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,710 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,810 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,830 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 88 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,544 new sales and 544 resales (2,088 purchases); new sales were 73.9% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 544 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 131 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 544 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 658 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.3%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
